scope: Preparation only; existing semantic labels and frozen saved outputs; no new metrics, training, inference or PnP.
evaluation_name: Semantic keypoint visibility transfer evaluation of query-pixel presence

v61.target: M4 target visible silhouette at nearest initial-query pixel, not semantic corner visibility
v61.crop: same frozen P3 9x9 ROI; predicted 2D span scale, not pose/K/dimension crop comparison

legacy.training: historical real CAL46; not synthetic-only comparator
legacy.self_state: S (geometry before RGB; not a classifier score)
legacy.other_states: U/T/missing remain separate; never force to negative

cohorts.paired_same_query_RGB: Known mapped human task label + saved valid initial query + legacy RGB score at exactly that coordinate. Preserve legacy RGB U abstentions.
cohorts.same_slot_pipeline: Known mapped human task label + valid initial query. Preserve S gate and U/T/missing; report all registered denominators and selective decision coverage separately. This cohort does not claim identical query location for geometric gates.
cohorts.all_registered_slots: Keep all 1784 rows and each exclusion/status; do not silently drop unknowns or OOB.

future_decision_scoring.v61: Saved present_at_fixed_0_5=True is positive; False is negative in each semantic transfer task.
future_decision_scoring.legacy_D_vs_E: B/I positive; O negative; S is a separate out-of-task prediction, retained in denominator and decision coverage, never forced to external.
future_decision_scoring.legacy_D_vs_ES: B/I positive; O or geometric S negative; identify S as a geometry decision separately from RGB.
future_decision_scoring.legacy_unresolved: U/T/missing remain unresolved outcomes in either task. Keep their rows in the task denominator; any selective confusion table must also show unresolved counts and coverage.
future_decision_scoring.ranking: Use p_present and p_DIRECT on paired_same_query_RGB rows, including RGB U. Never fabricate an RGB probability for S.

mapping: Use stored baseline N3 branch/permutation only for evaluation. These are historical GT-evaluation branches, not independent physical identity certification and never inference input. Exact stored qFinal parity checked. No new GT-best branch selection. Unmatched SQUARE_YOLO:026048 stays UNKNOWN.
native_slot_order: Local cuboid convention: 0 front top left, 1 front top right, 2 front bottom right, 3 front bottom left; 4-7 corresponding back-face order; 8 centroid excluded. These are local cuboid names, not image-coordinate sorting. Synthetic perm_v4[dynamic_id]=native_id is separate from real evaluation native-to-reference mapping; do not reapply it to already-dynamic saved arrays.
unannotated_slots: Historical metric-reference-only review: wood13 NO_REFERENCE, square346 pnp_projected. Never convert these to EXTERNAL or DIRECT from raw visibility=1/reason=unknown.
pixel_presence_reference: No real pixel segmentation reference verified. Semantic evaluation cannot establish real single-pixel presence accuracy.
diagnostics: Initial-to-reference pixel distance and fixed nominal crop coverage are evaluation-only; never recenter or resize crop using reference.
exposure: All 223 frames are repeated development material. No CAL46 exact ID or image-SHA overlap does not establish independent final evaluation.
reporting: Separate wood/square and recording; keep OOF/unannotated/mapping/query-OOB/no-RGB/S/U counts. Preserve paired improvement and damage denominators when metrics are later computed.
